data.name: Caritas
data.gender_notes: Caritas is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Caritas is derived from the Latin word 'caritas', which means 'love' or 'charity'. It is a name deeply rooted in Christian tradition and spirituality, representing the selfless and compassionate love of God and humanity. The name Caritas carries the meaning “Love, Charity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Caritas usually hope their child will grow to embody love, charity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of selfless love and compassion
data.etymology: Caritas belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love, Charity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Caritas total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: קָרִיטָס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאריטס נגזר מהמילה הלטינית לאהבה וחסד, וקשור למושגים של צדקה ונדיבות. בשורשו, המילה קאריטס קשורה למילה היוונית 'כאריס', שפירושה חסד או חיבה. השם קאריטס משמש לעתים קרובות בהקשר של אהבה אלוהית וחסד נוצרי.

in_greek.name: Καριτας
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καριτας προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη για την αγάπη και τη χάρη, και συνδέεται με έννοιες όπως η φιλανθρωπία και η γενναιοδωρία. Στην πνευματική του διάσταση, το όνομα Καριτας αντανακλά την έννοια της θείας αγάπης και της χάρης στον Χριστιανισμό.

in_latin.name: Caritas
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Caritas a Latina voce amoris et caritatis derivatur, et notionibus philanthropiae et liberalitatis coniungitur. In ecclesia primitiva, Caritas ad amore Dei et proximi referebatur, et virtus theologica considerabatur.

in_english.name: Caritas
in_english.long_meaning: The name Caritas originates from Latin, meaning love, charity, and kindness. Derived from the Greek 'charis,' meaning grace or favor, Caritas represents divine love and charity in Christian tradition. Historically, Caritas was considered a theological virtue, emphasizing love for God and one's neighbor. The name symbolizes compassion, generosity, and altruism, reflecting essential Christian values.

data.cultural_impact: The name Caritas holds a significant cultural impact, particularly in the context of the Christian tradition. It serves as a powerful reminder of the importance of love, kindness, and compassion in society. The name can be found in various religious institutions, organizations, and even personal names, reflecting the enduring value that love and charity hold in our shared cultural heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Caritas carries profound significance. It embodies the selfless love, mercy, and compassion that God extends to humanity. By bearing this name, one is called to emulate these virtues in their own life, striving to extend love and kindness to others and act as a beacon of hope and healing in the world. It is a constant reminder of the power of love to heal, uplift, and transform both individuals and communities.
